text:
Situation: Cefepime 2 g injection is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 95 vials (5.5 days) of one presentation and 282 vials (20.8 days) of another. Corvale General holds 321 vials (20.2 days) and 303 vials (18.9 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 45 vials (17.6 days). The top-ranked option is to transfer 99 vials from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East approximately 11 days of supply while Corvale General retains at least two weeks.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include cefepime as of 2026-10-21. FDA status shows "To Be Discontinued since -" with no date provided.

Our position: Internal redistribution is the fastest way to protect Corvale East's supply without relying on external purchases that lack identified manufacturing sites.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves transfer of 99 vials of cefepime 2 g from Corvale General to Corvale East.
2. Buyer monitors Apotex Corp., B. Braun Medical Inc., and Baxter Healthcare Corporation availability and reports any confirmed supply with identified plants.
3. Pharmacy director evaluates option 2 (9 vials from Corvale Lakeside) only if option 1 cannot be executed.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or alternative agent substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
